info.title: Matomo Reporting API for DBStats plugin

get.description: Gets some general information about this Matomo installation, including the count of websites tracked, the count of users and the total space used by the database.

200.description: Contains the website count, user count and total space used by the database.</br>Example links: [XML](https://demo.matomo.cloud/?module=API&method=DBStats.getGeneralInformation&format=xml&token_auth=anonymous), [JSON](https://demo.matomo.cloud/?module=API&method=DBStats.getGeneralInformation&format=JSON&token_auth=anonymous), [TSV (Excel)](https://demo.matomo.cloud/?module=API&method=DBStats.getGeneralInformation&format=Tsv&token_auth=anonymous)

get.description: Gets general database info that is not specific to any table.
Returns a datatable summarizing how data is distributed among Matomo tables.

200.description: A datatable with three columns: 'data_size', 'index_size', 'row_count'.</br>Example links: [XML](https://demo.matomo.cloud/?module=API&method=DBStats.getDatabaseUsageSummary&format=xml&token_auth=anonymous), [JSON](https://demo.matomo.cloud/?module=API&method=DBStats.getDatabaseUsageSummary&format=JSON&token_auth=anonymous), TSV (N/A)

get.description: Returns a datatable describing how much space is taken up by each log table.

200.description: A datatable with three columns: 'data_size', 'index_size', 'row_count'.</br>Example links: [XML](https://demo.matomo.cloud/?module=API&method=DBStats.getTrackerDataSummary&format=xml&token_auth=anonymous), [JSON](https://demo.matomo.cloud/?module=API&method=DBStats.getTrackerDataSummary&format=JSON&token_auth=anonymous), TSV (N/A)

get.description: Returns a datatable describing how much space is taken up by each numeric archive table.

get.description: Returns a datatable describing how much total space is taken up by each individual report type.

parameters.name: forceCache
parameters.description: false to use the cached result, true to run the queries again and cache the result.

200.description: A datatable with three columns: 'data_size', 'index_size', 'row_count'.</br>Example links: [XML](https://demo.matomo.cloud/?module=API&method=DBStats.getIndividualReportsSummary&format=xml&token_auth=anonymous), [JSON](https://demo.matomo.cloud/?module=API&method=DBStats.getIndividualReportsSummary&format=JSON&token_auth=anonymous), TSV (N/A)

get.description: Returns a datatable describing how much total space is taken up by each individual metric type.

parameters.name: forceCache

200.description: A datatable with three columns: 'data_size', 'index_size', 'row_count'.</br>Example links: [XML](https://demo.matomo.cloud/?module=API&method=DBStats.getIndividualMetricsSummary&format=xml&token_auth=anonymous), [JSON](https://demo.matomo.cloud/?module=API&method=DBStats.getIndividualMetricsSummary&format=JSON&token_auth=anonymous), TSV (N/A)

formatRequired.name: format
formatRequired.description: Response format such as `xml` or `json`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.

formatOptional.name: format
formatOptional.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.

flatOptional.name: flat
flatOptional.description: Flatten subtables into the parent table.

filter_columnOptional.name: filter_column
filter_columnOptional.description: Column to apply the regex to (e.g., `label`).

filter_column_recursiveOptional.name: filter_column_recursive
filter_column_recursiveOptional.description: Column for the recursive regex filter.

filter_excludelowpopOptional.name: filter_excludelowpop
filter_excludelowpopOptional.description: Column to threshold and exclude low values.

filter_truncateOptional.name: filter_truncate
filter_truncateOptional.description: Row index after which rows are removed.

filter_limitOptional.name: filter_limit
filter_limitOptional.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

hideColumnsOptional.name: hideColumns
hideColumnsOptional.description: Comma-separated list of columns to hide.

showColumnsOptional.name: showColumns
showColumnsOptional.description: Comma-separated list of columns to include.

labelOptional.name: label
labelOptional.description: Keep only rows with these label(s). Supports path via '>' and arrays.
